description: This file defines the CalendarAccountValidationService class, which provides validation methods for calendar account objects, including checks for personal account limits, group account creation permissions, and duplicate external calendars.

classes.name: CalendarAccountValidationService
classes.description: A service class for validating calendar account objects, including checks for account limits, permissions, and duplicates.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs all validation checks and returns true if no errors are found.

methods.name: getErrors
methods.description: Returns the list of validation errors encountered.

methods.name: getFirstError
methods.description: Returns the first validation error, if any.

methods.name: validatePersonalAccountLimit
methods.description: Checks if the user already has a personal calendar account and adds an error if so.

methods.name: validateGroupAccountCreation
methods.description: Ensures only admins can create group calendar accounts.

methods.name: validateDuplicateExternalCalendar
methods.description: Checks for duplicate external calendar IDs and adds an error if a duplicate is found.
